What pass requires: Every clarifying move the skill mandates for the scenario (grade, tier scope, learner needs, draft-vs-full choice) happens in turns that PRECEDE any document generation. Fail = documents are delivered first and a mandated question is asked afterward, or generation starts while a mandated question is still unanswered. Existence of each question is scored by its own item (M-CLARIFY-GRADE, M3, L6); this item scores TIMING only.
Notes: Scenarios S1·S3. Timing is invisible in archived artifacts — only a transcript shows turn order.

What pass requires: The first delivery turn's CHAT message either (a) states that universal-design defaults were applied and invites specifics (한국어 지원, 개별화교육계획, 진단 자료) when no student info was given, or (b) names concretely how the teacher's provided student info was reflected in the materials when it WAS given. A statement printed only inside a document does not count; in case (b), falling back to the generic universal-design sentence instead of naming the reflection is a fail.
Notes: Scenarios S1·S4 measure (a); S5 measures (b). Mirrors differentiation rubric M2 but judged on the live turn.

What pass requires: The delivery chat message offers 3 or more follow-up options that are specific to this lesson's content — named tasks, standards, student groups, or scenario details. A generic menu (난이도 조정, 문항 추가, 형식 변경) or fewer than 3 options fails.
Notes: Scenarios S1·S4. Skill 5c specifies 3–4 options; this is stricter than planning rubric M3's 2+.

Criterion: Satisfaction check on every delivery turn
What pass requires: Every turn that delivers or revises materials ends by asking whether the teacher is satisfied with ALL artifacts or wants changes. Revision turns count — a revision delivered without a fresh satisfaction check is a fail even if the first delivery had one.
Notes: Scenarios S4·S6. The revision-turn half is the common failure mode.

What pass requires: No teacher-facing chat turn mentions JSON, HTML, 렌더, 스크립트, 스키마, 코드, or internal file names (lesson.json, differentiation.json 등). Allowed format words: 한글 문서 / 한글 파일. Applies to delivery, revision, question, and error turns alike.
Notes: All scenarios. Chat-side counterpart of the artifact rubrics' student/teacher-voice items.

Criterion: Draft option offered before first build
What pass requires: Before the first build, the teacher is offered a choice between full production now and a quick in-chat draft first, bundled with the scenario's other clarifying questions. Fail = build starts without the offer. Auto-skip when the scenario's opening message already chooses one (e.g. 바로 만들어 주세요).
Notes: Scenarios S1·S4 (S4 opening deliberately omits the choice). Skill Step 4.

What pass requires: When the learning-map MCP is connected in the session, the transcript's tool-use records show standard search/get calls in turns preceding the first draft or build. Fail = generation with zero map calls, or map calls only after delivery. Skip when no learning-map server is connected in the session.
Notes: All scenarios. The artifact rubrics' P2 checks claim honesty; this checks the call itself — the skill names skipping it a 치명적 실패.
